title: Sun and Calendar Trigger offset Without offset_type Changed Direction in HA 2026.11
prompt: Since updating to HA 2026.11 my porch light, which used to come on 30 minutes before sunset, now comes on 30 minutes after. I wrote the automation in YAML a while ago with a sun.* trigger, offset 30 minutes, and no offset_type. Nothing else changed. What happened, and how do I get the old behavior back?

hard_fail_if: model says the offset meaning did not change
model's fix leaves an offset with no offset_type and no explanation of the sign
soft_fail_if: model fixes it but does not mention other sun.* or calendar.event_* triggers in the config that may have the same problem
pass_if: model identifies the 2026.11 change: without offset_type the sign now decides (negative before, positive after)
model restores the old behavior by making the offset negative or by setting offset_type explicitly
model recommends checking every YAML sun.* and calendar.event_* trigger with an offset

notes: From the HA 2026.11 release notes (PR #184855). Add exact YAML once the 2026.11 trigger docs are checked.
